title: Design Services for NYSTA Fueling Facilities
short_description: Redevelopment of 29 highway fueling facilities including canopies, buildings, and structural works.
project_location: Albany, New York, USA; 27 food/fuel facilities along the New York State Thruway.
project_scope: The project covers redevelopment, operation, and maintenance of 29 fueling facilities at 27 food/fuel facilities along the New York State Thruway. Scope includes design, construction, and financing of fueling areas, forecourts, canopies, kiosks, retail buildings, fuel dispensing infrastructure, pavement, striping, signage, utilities, and all elements within the defined fueling facility responsibility areas. The notice indicates rehabilitation and refurbishment as part of the assignment.
services: Architecture services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering; overall design-build-finance type redevelopment with operation and maintenance component.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering and canopy/building components, which are potentially relevant to sbp.
- Project involves multiple roadside fueling facilities rather than a single architecturally or structurally outstanding structure.
- Main focus is redevelopment, operation, maintenance, and financing, not primarily advanced structural design.
- Canopies and retail buildings may contain some special-structure potential, but no spans, innovative systems, or notable complexity are stated.
- Transportation-related infrastructure is adjacent to highways, yet it is not a bridge or major long-span roof project.
- Overall only moderately relevant due to broad multidisciplinary scope and limited evidence of demanding structural challenges.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The project includes 29 fueling facilities at 27 service areas with canopies, kiosks, retail buildings, fuel systems, pavement, signage, and utilities, plus redevelopment, operation, maintenance, and financing responsibilities. This suggests a potentially large program, but no reliable USD construction estimate can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Because the procurement combines design, construction, financing, operation, and maintenance across 29 fueling facilities, a realistic structural engineering fee for sbp cannot be isolated from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Bidders must be qualified, experienced, and financially secure firms. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: New York State Thruway Authority (NYSTA), Albany, NY, USA. Contact: Sarah Normile, email: sarah.normile@thruway.ny.gov, phone: 518-436-2740. Questions contact: Caitlin Cady (Caitlin.Cady@thruway.ny.gov) or Andrew Trombley (Andrew.Trombley@thruway.ny.gov). Website: https://pbss.thruway.ny.gov/index.aspx
notes: Project No. 24C20. Registration deadline: 2026-04-30. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-05-04 10:00 AM EDT at 80 Wolf Rd, Colonie, NY 12205-2608, USA; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-05-29 05:00 PM EDT. Contract participation goals: MWBE 30%, SDVOB 6%. The notice is an RFP/RFQ for redevelopment, operation, and maintenance of fueling facilities immediately accessible from the New York State Thruway.
